This is a security-relevant change. R-SESSION-EXPIRY sits under N-ACCOUNT-SAFE and RISK-ACCOUNT-TAKEOVER, which is the reason the 30-minute limit exists. A session that stays valid for twice as long gives an attacker who reuses a stolen token twice the window. I made the change because you asked for it, but you may want the requirement owner to sign off on it.

I haven't committed anything.
